is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae (M and S molecular forms) across multiple African countries (p. 1, 3, 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotypes target markers Vgsc-1014F (L995F) and Vgsc-1575Y (N1570Y) in wild-caught An. gambiae from Benin and Burkina Faso (p. 3, 6, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: While GSTe2-114T (non-target marker) frequencies are mapped in Figure 5, complete genotype or allele counts for the target markers Vgsc-1014F and Vgsc-1575Y are not provided in the main text or figures (only p-values, odds ratios, and partial overall frequencies like Vgsc-1575Y freq = 0.035 in Benin and 0.12 in Burkina Faso are given on p. 3). Complete genotype data reside in external supplementary files Dataset S1 and Dataset S2.

african_field_population.evidence: Wild-caught female Anopheles gambiae collected from field sites in Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, and Uganda (p. 3, 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study reporting original bioassays, genotyping, molecular modelling, crystallography, and transgenic assays.

sub_country_location.evidence: Main text and figures only report data at the country level; specific sub-country collection locations are stated to be in Table S3 in File S1 (p. 5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years for the field-caught mosquito samples are not specified in the main text or figures.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Field specimens were obtained from previously published resistance monitoring studies or collections (e.g., Badolo et al. 2012 [ref 49], Jones et al. 2012 [ref 5], Weetman et al. 2010 [ref 6]) (p. 3, 9).

supplement.evidence: Target marker genotype datasets and specific collection location details are housed in external supplementary files 'Dataset S1 (CSV)', 'Dataset S2 (CSV)', and 'Table S3 in File S1' which are not included in the provided document (p. 3, 5, 9).

assessment.summary: This study demonstrates how metabolic (GSTe2-I114T) and target-site (Vgsc-1014F and Vgsc-1575Y) mechanisms combine to confer high DDT resistance in Anopheles gambiae from West Africa. While target markers Vgsc-1014F and Vgsc-1575Y were genotyped in wild mosquitoes from Benin and Burkina Faso, extractable genotype counts/frequencies for these target markers are missing from the main text and figures, relying instead on unprovided supplementary datasets (Dataset S1 and Dataset S2).
exclusion_reasons: Missing extractable genotype counts/frequencies for target markers (Vgsc-1014F and Vgsc-1575Y) in the provided main text/figures; full genotype data are in unprovided supplementary datasets (Dataset S1 and Dataset S2).
